note: English HTML catalogs at /en/creditcard/details/boccreditcard.html (7 tiles: Cheers, Chill, Private, Visa Infinite, Dual Currency, i-card, UnionPay Dual Currency Diamond) and /en/creditcard/details/cobrand.html (18 co-brand, university and association tiles). Each tile is li.card with the product name in h1 and the product link in a.morelink. The favourite star image is skipped by the /dam/ src filter. The Vue listing at /dam/boccreditcard/cardproductlisting/eng/index.html is a JS shell; its catalog body is /dam/boccreditcard/cardproductlisting/js/data/card-en.js, which is a JavaScript assignment, not a public JSON file, so recipe.py source:json cannot parse it. BOC Go Card and BOC Bliss Card appear in that Vue catalog and are not on these two HTML catalogs; read them from card-en.js or their DAM product pages. The Visa Infinite Card tile is still on boccreditcard.html, but the product page says the card was renamed to BOC Cheers Card from 1 August 2023, so do not hand it in as a separate current card.
